$comment: Golden fixtures for the cross-platform paragraph-numbering contract (comment anchors). Canonical copy: Twistloom-web/tests/unit/fixtures/paragraph_segmentation.json, harnessed by tests/unit/utils/splitParagraphs.fixture.test.ts. Mirror: Twistloom-flutter/test/fixtures/paragraph_segmentation.json, harnessed by test/features/reader/anchor_paragraphs_test.dart. Rule: split on one-or-two escaped-newline sequences (backslash + n as two characters) or one-or-two literal newlines; segments are returned verbatim; whitespace-only segments are dropped. Each case's paragraphs array IS the 1-based paragraph numbering used by comment anchors on both platforms. Any change must land in BOTH repos in the same review: READER_PAGE_COMMENT_SECTION_ROADMAP.md (web) Step 1 and READER_PARAGRAPH_COMMENTS_ROADMAP.md (Flutter) Q2/Step 2.
